A [[human]] individual was the '''doorman''' of a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in the [[Leisure Zone]] on the planet [[Morlana One]]. In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Episode 1" /> he<ref name="AD Kassa">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> scanned [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] before allowing him to enter the brothel.<ref name="Episode 1" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The doorman first appeared in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the debut episode of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Episode 1" /> which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Tim Faraday]].<ref name="Episode 1" />
